description: HOMESERVER module installs and maintains Caduceus. It provisions the agathodaimon Python environment and maintains the sudoers refresh consumer.

args: import pathlib, site; roots = [pathlib.Path(path) for path in site.getsitepackages() if path.endswith('/site-packages')]; assert len(roots) == 1 and roots[0].is_dir(); roots[0].joinpath('caduceus-staff.pth').write_text('/usr/local/sbin\n', encoding='utf-8')

managed_files.content:
[Unit]
Description=Caduceus HOMESERVER appliance API
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/caduceus serve
Environment=CADUCEUS_BIND=0.0.0.0:3014
Environment=PYTHONPATH=/usr/local/sbin
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

caduceus_profile_source.append:
profile: homeserver
mode: homeserver
capability:
  household_verifying_key:
  default_ttl_seconds: 60
harmonia_profile: /etc/harmonia/profiles/homeserver/index.json
services:
  ledger: /var/lib/harmonia/receipts/homeserver-ledger.jsonl
  update:
    timer: harmonia.timer
    latest_receipt: /var/lib/harmonia/receipts/update-latest/run.json
  coronatio:
    latest_receipt: /var/lib/harmonia/receipts/homeserver-activate-latest/modules/coronatio/run.json
  caduceus:
    latest_receipt: /var/lib/harmonia/receipts/homeserver-activate-latest/modules/caduceus/run.json
harmonia_routes:
  update_now:
    bin: /usr/local/bin/harmonia
    args:
    - homeserver-update
    - /etc/harmonia/profiles/homeserver/index.json
    - --apply
    - --receipt-dir
    - /var/lib/harmonia/receipts/update-latest
  update_check:
    bin: /usr/local/bin/harmonia
    args:
    - homeserver-update
    - /etc/harmonia/profiles/homeserver/index.json
    - --receipt-dir
    - /var/lib/harmonia/receipts/update-latest
operator_aliases:
  update: caduceus update now
  update-check: caduceus update check
  update-status: caduceus update status
  receipts: caduceus receipts latest
  health: caduceus health
